name: schema-version-bump-same-target
description: A define-field version bump that only changes value_type (not strategy) needs no distinct target and folds correctly today (spec/schema-ops.md §Evolution, Correction 1): op_version 1 and op_version 2 of widget-op both declare field 'value' as lww, so both land in the same accumulator regardless of which rule a caller's slice lists first, because the strategy the accumulator runs is identical either way. v2's later write simply overwrites v1's under ordinary last-writer-wins.
